text:
Omar S: Hey CS — closing Cliffside (midmarket). Passing to @Lucy_CS for onboarding. Contract start 2024-06-01. Primary asks: private deploy (VPC peering), Okta SSO, and a Dedicated capacity estimate. Billing contact is finance@cliffside.io. MRR $18k.

Lucy CS: Thanks Omar — looping in support & enablement. Quick gaps we need filled: billing contact confirmed, VPC CIDR, AWS account ID, expected QPS, and Okta metadata. Also flagging potential renewal sensitivity if 95th-pct latency > 200ms at launch. Assigning owners below. :spiral_calendar: 

Raja Support: I can own infra triage. Need VPC CIDR + AWS account + target QPS. Also, do they need private DNS or internal endpoints?

Omar S: VPC CIDR 10.20.0.0/16, AWS acct 9876543210, expected QPS ~40 steady, ~150 peak. They want internal endpoints behind peering and private DNS. SOW: https://redwood.example/sow/cliffside (internal).

Lucy CS: Perfect. I'll create kickoff and support ticket. Owners: Lucy = CS AM, Raja = Support/ENG lead, Marta = Enablement. Action items (next steps):
1) Raja to open ENG ticket for VPC peering & routing (include CIDR/account).
2) Omar/Cliffside to share Okta metadata and admin list.
3) Marta to draft customer runbook + 60-min enablement session.
4) Lucy to schedule kickoff and track SLA targets (latency SLO).

Marta Enablement: I'll make a runbook (deployment checklist, sample prompts, mitigation playbook for latency regressions) and a short recorded walkthrough. Please add the admin users early.

Alex (Cliffside): Hi — Alex here. Admins: tanya@cliffside.io, mike@cliffside.io. We'll send Okta metadata by EOD and prefer a kickoff week of May 22.

Raja Support: Opening ticket ENG-4821 with initial notes and owners. Ticket link: https://redwood.example/tickets/ENG-4821

`ticket-bot: Ticket ENG-4821 created and assigned to eng-oncall, priority: P2.`

Raja Support: Notes added to ENG-4821: VPC 10.20.0.0/16, peer with account 9876543210, private DNS requirement, expected peak QPS 150. Next infra steps: 1) accept peering, 2) add routes, 3) update SGs to allow 443 from peer, 4) verify endpoints. I'll post checklist in the ticket.

Lucy CS: New owners in thread. I'll kick off calendar invites once Marta posts runbook draft. Follow-up meeting: tentative May 24 10am PT. :calendar:

Omar S: Thanks team — appreciate fast turnaround. If anything blocks timeline ping me and I’ll escalate with the customer. :thumbsup:
